head.h1: Iftar at Home Dubai: Menu and Planning Guide
head.meta_description: Plan iftar at home in Dubai with a considered menu, service timed for Maghrib and clear questions about preparation, dietary needs and pricing.

opening_paragraph: Iftar at home in Dubai brings family and guests together around a meal timed for Maghrib. A clear menu and service plan let the first dates, water and soup arrive comfortably, followed by the main dishes and a relaxed finish.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Plan the order of the meal
replace_in_block.new_heading: Plan the order of the meal
new_paragraphs: Prepare a simple first service of dates, water and soup, then allow the main meal to follow at a comfortable pace. Mezze, grilled dishes, rice and a choice of desserts can create a generous table without asking the kitchen to finish everything at once.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Confirm the timing for your date
replace_in_block.new_heading: Confirm the timing for your date
new_paragraphs: Check the published prayer time for the event date and location, then work backward to agree arrival, setup and readiness. The first service should be prepared before guests need it, with the team briefed on the sequence of the evening.

Confirm halal sourcing and any specific certificates or preparation expectations. Collect allergies and other dietary requirements early, so the culinary partner can assess the menu and explain any remaining cross-contact risk.

A family-style table, staffed buffet and private plated dinner require different staffing and preparation. Request a quote for the format you want, including food, equipment, service and clear-down. A price for a two-person dinner should not be assumed to cover a larger iftar gathering.

Compare the complete service, including the menu, guest count, preparation, staffing, equipment, delivery and clear-down. A per-person price is useful only when the inclusions are clear. Ask which elements are fixed and which can change if your plans change.

Share allergies and other dietary requirements before confirming. The culinary partner should explain the preparation arrangements and any remaining cross-contact risk. Review the payment schedule, cancellation terms and change deadlines in your written booking.

Send the date, Dubai address, expected guest count and preferred service time, together with your menu ideas and venue details. Photos of the kitchen or service area can help the team assess what is practical.

myCHEF typically replies within 15 minutes between 9am and 9pm Dubai time. The tailored proposal follows once the requirements and availability have been reviewed. A first reply is an acknowledgement, rather than confirmation that a chef or date has been secured.
